metadata.title: AlphaFold3 on TPU and GPU: inputs, targets, manifests, data freeze and run records
metadata.description:
Record R1 of the study: the frozen AlphaFold3 inputs with their ColabFold MSAs, targets, manifests, every data freeze (final identifier 689230120499e5ba9d903051553c6554f3412f462456461757398f8fd3560a1a, 295 sessions), session lists, the run records of the main study and follow-ups 1 to 12, and the records of sessions outside the freeze mapped to the analysis plan.

No AlphaFold3 Output and no model parameters are in this record. The outputs, the results of AlphaFold3's data pipeline and the follow-up 6 deliveries are in the companion record, 10.5281/zenodo.24057544, under the AlphaFold 3 Output Terms of Use. Provenance files are released with the contact address and home paths redacted; REDACTIONS.tsv lists each file with the SHA-256 of the original and of the released copy. LICENCES.md gives the licence of every third-party source and of each archive.

Paper: see the related identifiers of this Zenodo record (arXiv preprint and conference version, added when available).
